request: Does the sofa colour go with the floor? Explain the visible palette and one optional small improvement. Do not change anything.

reply.message:
Yes—the muted sage sofa works well with the floor’s visible warm taupe tones. The beige rug and cream walls soften the contrast, while walnut brown, terracotta and brass add warmth to the earthy palette. Rendered sunlight makes part of the sofa appear more yellow than its specified sage colour.

One optional small improvement: a slightly lighter cream rug would give the sofa clearer contrast against the floor.

Nothing has been changed.
